idea-plugin.name: piilex - PII Scanner
idea-plugin.description:
piilex - PII Scanner for JetBrains IDEs

Detect personally identifiable information (PII) in your source code in real-time.

Features

  • 50+ PII types - email, phone, SSN, credit card, My Number, IBAN, and more
  • 6 languages - TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, C#
  • Data flow tracing - alerts when PII flows to logs, databases, or APIs
  • Quick fixes - apply masking/redaction suggestions with Alt+Enter
  • Regulatory mapping - GDPR, CCPA, APPI, HIPAA, PCI-DSS (Pro)

Requirements

The piilex binary must be installed and available in PATH.

Install: brew install piilex/tap/piilex or npm install -g piilex
